mapper.select: SELECT SUM(day1.show_pv) AS show_pv, SUM(day1.click_pv) AS click_pv, SUM(day1.req_pv) AS req_pv, SUM(day1.discard) AS discard, SUM(day1.ret_pv) AS ret_pv, SUM(day1.spend) AS spend, SUM(day1.income) AS income, SUM(day1.discount_click_pv) AS discount_click_pv, SUM(day1.discount_show_pv) AS discount_show_pv, SUM(day1.dplsucc_pv) AS dplsucc_pv, SUM(day1.complete_pv) AS complete_pv, SUM(day1.install_pv) AS install_pv, SUM(day1.activate_pv) AS activate_pv FROM data_ssp_slot_day day1 WHERE day1.date BETWEEN #{date[0]} AND #{date[1]}

SELECT day.*, ssp.name_alise AS sspName, app.name AS appName, app.os_type AS osType, media.media_company_short AS mediaName FROM data_ssp_slot_day AS day LEFT JOIN ssp_slot_info AS ssp ON day.ssp_slot_id = ssp.id LEFT JOIN ssp_app AS app ON app.id = ssp.app_id LEFT JOIN ssp_media AS media ON media.id = ssp.media_id WHERE day.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} and day.date = #{date} ORDER BY day.id DESC
SELECT day.* FROM data_ssp_slot_day AS day WHERE day.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND day.date = #{inputTime} AND day.dsp_slot_code = #{dspSlotCode}

SELECT media.id AS mediaId, media.media_company_name AS mediaName, SUM(day.show_pv) AS showPv, SUM(day.click_pv) AS clickPv, SUM(day.req_pv) AS reqPv, SUM(day.req_count) AS reqCount, SUM(day.discard) AS discard, SUM(day.ret_pv) AS retPv, SUM(day.spend) AS spend, SUM(day.income) AS income, SUM(day.discount_click_pv) AS discountClickPv, SUM(day.discount_show_pv) AS discountShowPv, SUM(day.dplsucc_pv) AS dplsuccPv, SUM(day.complete_pv) AS completePv, SUM(day.install_pv) AS installPv, SUM(day.activate_pv) AS activatePv, #{date} AS date FROM data_ssp_slot_day day INNER JOIN ssp_slot_info slot ON slot.id = day.ssp_slot_id AND slot.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ssp_media media ON media.id = slot.media_id AND media.deleted = 0 WHERE day.date = #{date} AND day.deleted = 0 GROUP BY media.id, media.media_company_name ORDER BY media.id
select * from data_ssp_slot_day where ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND dsp_slot_id =#{dspSlotId} AND date = #{date}
